description: Generate complete screenplay packages with metadata, characters, locations, scenes, elements, assets, and previsualization

items.task: Fix failing tests - updated test fixtures and test inputs to match script interfaces
Run tests and verify they pass
Break down inputs for non-technical users - replaced single JSON blob with 17 individual user-friendly inputs
Remove 12 orphaned/disconnected nodes from pipeline graph - moved unused .ts files to _orphaned_nodes/

Fix dialogue and previs generation - element-generation now explicitly generates dialogue/shot elements, previs-generation now correctly reads section.beats and falls back to generating previs from beats when no shot elements exist
Update input-validation tests to work with object outputs instead of JSON strings
Fix ForEach loop not executing __script_file__ nodes - added handler for v2 file-backed script nodes in executeForEachBodyNode function in composition-run.ts
Fix final-assembly to populate section children with elements - added populateSectionChildren function that distributes elements to their parent scene sections based on beat counts

Fix asset-collection to actually save assets to Woodbury library - now calls asset_collection_create to create collection and asset_save with correct parameters (file_path not path, collection slug not ID) to persist assets
Fix params.tags.split is not a function bug in creator-assets extension - added normalizeTags() helper that handles both string and array inputs for tags parameter

Fix zero elements bug - sections have nested structure (acts containing scenes) but ForEach only iterated top-level. Updated scene-content-generation, element-generation, previs-generation, and final-assembly to recursively process nested children
